scope: Independent review of secp256k1 and P256 native kernels, code generators, interpreter references, and public modules

findings.issue: A redundant Bool.from_rts_int32 followed compile_comparison, which already returns i64. Verification generated an invalid Wasm operand type.
findings.resolution: Owner independently removed the extra extension immediately before the auditor reported it.
findings.status: resolved and verified on final shared dist artifacts

findings.issue: ecdsa 0.16.9 forwards the unreduced prehash into RFC6979 nonce derivation. Digests at least the scalar order therefore disagree with RFC6979 bits2octets and the interpreter.
findings.discovery: Implementation agents' independent boundary vectors; audit independently checks 18 cases per curve using Python integer/hashlib arithmetic.
findings.resolution: Both kernels reduce the 32-byte digest modulo the scalar order before invoking the upstream signer.
findings.status: resolved and verified on final shared dist artifacts

findings.issue: Bypassing SigningKey removed its Drop zeroization for the temporary NonZeroScalar copy; NonZeroScalar supports Zeroize but has no Drop.
findings.resolution: Owner explicitly zeroizes the temporary scalar after invoking the upstream signer and before propagating errors. The new secret-tweak operation also clears its temporary scalar, encoded bytes and ABI scratch.
findings.status: resolved and verified on final shared dist artifacts

review.encoding: Strict SEC1 key lengths/tags, field bounds, on-curve validation, nonzero ECDSA components, canonical DER and exact consumption reviewed.
review.native_abi: Operation-sized outputs initialize every byte including errors, input getters are resolved after output allocation, and pointer borrow intervals contain no GC safepoints.
review.boolean_status: P256 i64 status 0/1 matches the SDK's vanilla Bool; secp256k1 comparison conversion reviewed against actual compiler source.
review.state: Runtime kernels have no mutable retained state, callbacks, OS imports or native allocation. Wasm imports inspected: shared memory and PIC/stack globals only.
review.reference: Portable Num.Big_int arithmetic with no reference subprocesses; deterministic nonce retry, low-S policy, Schnorr even-Y lift and signature equations reviewed.
review.limits: Tests and review are not a formal proof or side-channel certification. Interpreter big-integer arithmetic is variable-time. Cross-message GC validation belongs to the shared crypto-gc integration suite. Rare RFC6979 nonce rejection is reviewed in the upstream and reference loops; the audit does not claim to force a rejected HMAC candidate.

reproduction: From ../motoko_sha: nix develop --command python3 ../plugins/tests/crypto-audit/curves/run_audit.py --motoko . --secp ABS_STAGED_DIST/secp256k1 --p256 ABS_STAGED_DIST/p256
